episodes.topic: First winter evening - garam mungphali eaten on the way home

episodes.title: Shaadi Ka Card Aa Gaya!
episodes.topic: Wedding season invitation - no new clothes, tailor busy, re-use old suits

episodes.title: Bijli Ka Bill Dugna!
episodes.topic: Power bill shock - AC at 16 and chargers left plugged in

episodes.title: Aloo Kis Ne Churaya?
episodes.topic: Sunday Sindhi biryani - one aloo goes missing from the degh

episodes.title: Tankhwa Aa Gayi!
episodes.topic: Abba's salary day - everyone lines up with demands (needs vs wants)

episodes.title: Data Khatam, Call Band!
episodes.topic: Mobile data finished - Ammi's video call with Nimra cuts off (night-time hotspot gaming)

episodes.title: Garam Paani Kis Ka?
episodes.topic: First cold winter morning - one geyser, Arsalan's long bath finishes all the hot water

episodes.title: Sair Ya Smog?
episodes.topic: Winter smog morning - Abba's new morning-walk plan, air quality app says stay in, indoor exercise

episodes.title: Ajrak Kahan Gayi?
episodes.topic: Sindhi Culture Day school prep - Mehak needs Abba's old ajrak, whole house searches, it was on Abba's shoulders

episodes.title: Karachi Ka Safar, Razai Samet!
episodes.topic: Long weekend (Iqbal Day) + cheaper petrol - family car trip to Nimra in Karachi; Ammi packs razaiyan but Karachi is still hot

episodes.title: Remote Kis Ke Paas?
episodes.topic: Winter evening TV fight - news vs cricket match vs drama, remote missing, toddler Hashir using it as a phone; Abba makes a fair TV schedule

episodes.title: Zukam Ya Drama?
episodes.topic: First cold windy evening - Arsalan plays cricket without a sweater, catches a light cold, over-acts to skip tomorrow's test; Ammi's ilaaj list (joshanda, no phone, no cricket) cures him instantly

episodes.title: Machhar Ki Adalat!
episodes.topic: Evening mosquito attack + dengue alert - Daniyal wants to 'sue' the mosquito; stagnant water under Ammi's rose pot and old bucket found; prevention (empty water, full sleeves, net, doctor for high fever)

episodes.title: Ghutne Ya App?
episodes.topic: Sudden November drizzle in Sindh - Ammi's knees vs Mehak's weather app, washed clothes in the aangan, Arsalan leaves his own uniform out, rain pakoray but besan finished, Arsalan comes back soaked holding a closed umbrella

episodes.title: Dhoop Ka Kona!
episodes.topic: First cold snap of winter - Sunday morning sun reaches only one corner of the aangan; Abba books the sunny charpai, Daniyal objects, Imtiaz queues, Abba dozes under a razai; by noon the sun is everywhere; Ammi brings chai and a fair turn rule

episodes.title: Gajar Ka Halwa!
episodes.topic: Winter carrot season - Abba brings 5 kg cheap gajar, nobody wants to grate them, Abba's 'humare zamane' boast makes it his job; low evening gas pressure slows the halwa; Daniyal 'khushboo ka gawah', Arsalan 'studied gajar ke fawaid' and gets the ladle; helpers get the first plates, Daniyal gets dishes duty

episodes.title: Dadi Ka Sweater!
episodes.topic: Cold wave - winter sweaters come out (naphthalene smell), Arsalan's last-year sweater too small because he grew (goes to Mehak), Abba gives him Dadi's hand-knitted 30-year-old sweater; embarrassed at first, next morning in gali cricket he is the only one not shivering

episodes.title: Ludo Ka Mukadma!
episodes.topic: Cold Sunday night family ludo - Abba's no-phone rule, loser makes chai; losing Abba blames the dice, dice disappears, toddler Hashir reveals 'Dada jeb!'; Abba makes chai and admits the phone-free night was the best

episodes.title: Project Kal Hai!
episodes.topic: Monday night school project panic - Mehak's 'water cycle' model 'due tomorrow', family builds it from home things (steel plate, cotton clouds, blue shopper sea), Hamza grabs a cotton cloud; diary says due Tuesday 24 November - next week

episodes.title: Do Tamatar!
episodes.topic: Tomato prices high + winter gas timings - Abba brings only two tomatoes, toddler Hamza takes the bag as his 'ball', Bhabi Sana makes the salan with dahi and imli instead; the two tomatoes saved in the fridge 'high security'

episodes.title: Dhund Ya Chashma?
episodes.topic: Dense winter fog morning - Arsalan wants a fog holiday, Faraz's glasses steam up from hot chai and he thinks the fog came inside; fog clears by 10, school van arrives; safety (slow bike, lights on)

episodes.title: Hont Ka Mukadma!
episodes.topic: Cold dry winter winds - law student Daniyal's lips crack the day before his moot court; he drinks only 'two glasses - of chai'; Ammi's naaf-mein-sarson-ka-tel totka ('Ammi ka qanoon, no appeal'), Bhabi Sana: water, vaseline, don't lick lips; by evening he can smile again

episodes.title: Bachon Ka Din!
episodes.topic: 20 November Universal Children's Day - Arsalan brings a list of demands (no homework, double pocket money), hires 'lawyer' Daniyal; Ammi: rights come with responsibilities (half homework = half pocket money); Abba lets the youngest child judge - toddler Hamza hands Arsalan his homework copy: 'pa-ho!'

episodes.title: Abba Ka Voice Note!
episodes.topic: Abba's first WhatsApp voice note to Nimra in Karachi - first try sends only 'Nimra', second try a 10-minute winter-advice lecture that also records Ammi's scolding (milk boiled over while he was 'watching' it); Nimra laughs but loves hearing his voice; 'pehle chulha band kar ke'

episodes.title: Dholki Ki Practice!
episodes.topic: Wedding season (Decemberistan) - cousin Rabia's mehndi in a week, no dholak at home; Abba wants quiet for his newspaper/news; toddler Hashir's steel plate becomes the dholak; Abba, once the mohalla's best dholak player, takes over and becomes the loudest

episodes.title: Paanch Kilo Matar!
episodes.topic: Winter green-peas season + high vegetable prices - Daniyal buys 5 kg cheap matar instead of half kg ('bulk deal'), whole family shells them in the evening, Daniyal eats them as 'quality check', Abba's 'matar used to be bigger' excuse; Sana freezes the extra (blanch + freezer), Ammi: next time Mehak buys vegetables

episodes.title: Aakhri Paratha!
episodes.topic: Cold winter morning - only one paratha left; Arsalan already ate three, claims the last one, 'checks' it on the way to Ada Imtiaz; Imtiaz kindly gives it to him and leaves for office; at night Ammi makes Arsalan knead tomorrow's dough

episodes.title: Nayi Razai Kis Ki?
episodes.topic: Cold November nights in Sindh - only one new razai; Daniyal and Arsalan fight over it, Ammi makes turns and promises a second one; next night the new razai is missing - Abba took it from the sun thinking it was his; the second new razai was in the boys' almari all along; share it

episodes.title: Ek Balti Ka Challenge!
episodes.topic: Water shortage morning - tanki khaali, motor only pulls air (no line water); Faraz blamed ('Health Department, Water Board nahi'); Sana's one saved bucket for Imtiaz before office, Abba's 'humare zamane mein ek balti', Imtiaz 'mei you shui'; evening water comes, fill buckets at night; Abba wants two buckets, Sana turns his catchphrase back on him

episodes.title: Safai Ka Din!
episodes.topic: Wedding-season cleaning day before guests - Ammi declares safai, Abba appoints himself 'supervisor'; under the boys' bed Arsalan finds his old bat and Daniyal his first law book and sits reading ('museum khul gaya?'); by evening Abba is caught reading a 5-year-old newspaper from under the sofa; Abba promises to make tea for the guests

episodes.title: Kis Ki Chai Kaun Si?
episodes.topic: Cold winter evening chai orders - everyone wants a different chai (Abba kadak, Ammi pheeki, Daniyal 3 spoons sugar, Mehak half milk); Mehak the 'expert waiter' turns the tray at the door and the cups swap; Abba refuses to swap back because he got the sweet one; Sana makes Daniyal a fresh cup
